capabilities: Scan notes for local audio links
Transcribe linked audio via OpenAI, Tencent Cloud ASR, or iFlytek ASR
Run transcription manually or automatically on note changes
Separate speakers with a shared diarization setting
disambiguation: Not an audio player or recorder; it transcribes audio files already linked in notes.
extras: Plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Audio content is sent to the configured third-party transcription provider; Tencent Cloud local upload is limited to 5 MB files. README includes developer release and offline-install script instructions (partly in Chinese) alongside user documentation.
problem: Obsidian can link and record audio but cannot transcribe audio files referenced in notes, so users must transcribe externally and paste results manually.

relations.evidence: Tencent Cloud recording file recognition (CreateRecTask with local base64 audio upload)

requires.name: OpenAI API key, Tencent Cloud ASR credentials, or iFlytek APPID/APIKey/APISecret

summary: Audio transcription plugin that scans local audio links in notes and inserts transcripts from OpenAI, Tencent Cloud ASR, or iFlytek ASR.
